name: IMO Prelim Past Paper
statement:
In $\triangle ABC$, $M$ is the mid-point of $AB$, $D$ is the foot of perpendicular from $A$ to $BC$,
and $P$ is a point on $MD$ (suitably extended if necessary) such that $CP$ is
perpendicular to $MD$. If $AB = 3$, $BD =1$ and $PB = PC$ , find the length of $AC$ corrected to 6 d.p..
